facts.fact: NITDA's director-general said NITDA issued a Cloud First policy in 2019 to discourage ministries and agencies from building their own data centres and to use cloud services, and that as policy everyone is bound to comply.

The same interview describes a newly signed National Sovereign Cloud initiative, backed by three guideline documents (policy framework, technical service provider, quality assurance) produced after a technical working group set up in November 2024; the article is dated 2026-08-20 and gives no signing date.
